candidate: ML-5 deployment-threshold rule + score calibrator (NOT DEPLOYED; evaluation artifact)

threshold_rule.population: deployment's own attack-free onboarding tail (last 35% of onboarding rows, scored with a baseline fitted on the head)
threshold_rule.alpha_selection: maximise the mean F1 over the DEV deployments of the deployment-specific rule (alpha grid above); ties -> larger alpha

shipped_detector_vehicle_threshold_rule.note: same rule on the shipped detector's frozen fused score (secondary vehicle)

calibration.selection: lowest mean log-loss in leave-one-profile-out cross-validation on the DEV pool; must also lower the mean ECE vs identity
